neighbours.label: negation of a stance, willingness or liability in a reported or official statement (denied that, does not believe, would not want, will not be responsible); not plain negated events
fire: Speaking to reporters after the vote, the senator said he would not want to see any hospital close, and he denied that the cuts had been agreed in advance.
The airline accepts bags at the owner's risk, and under these terms it will not be liable for any delay or loss during the journey.
Some economists expect a recession next year, but the bank's chief analyst does not believe the slowdown will last, and she does not see the need for emergency measures.
In an interview with the local paper, the factory owner denied that workers had been threatened and said he would never ask anyone to hide an injury.
Tickets are sold on the understanding that the organisers will not be held responsible for changes to the programme or for any costs that result.
Asked whether she regretted the decision, the coach said she did not think the team had been treated unfairly and would not want to reopen the argument.
The landlord told the tribunal that he had never refused a repair, and he denied that the tenants had complained about the heating.
The report's authors say they do not accept the ministry's figures and do not believe the target can be met by the end of the decade.
quiet: Speaking to reporters after the vote, the senator said he would like to see every hospital stay open, and he confirmed that the cuts had been agreed in advance.
The airline accepts bags at the counter, and under these terms it will pay a fixed sum for any delay or loss during the journey.
Some economists expect a recession next year, and the bank's chief analyst believes the slowdown will last, so she sees the need for emergency measures.
The storm closed the harbour for three days, and the ferry did not sail again until the wind dropped on Thursday morning.
Tickets are sold from the booth by the gate, and the organisers will announce changes to the programme on the notice board each morning.
The old mill burned down in the nineties, and the site was not cleared until a developer bought the land ten years later.
The landlord told the tribunal that he had always approved repairs, and he agreed that the tenants had complained about the heating.
The parcel was posted on Monday, but it had not arrived by the weekend and the tracking page showed nothing new.

notes: Both poles peak on ' not'. Probes: short negated sentences score under 0.2; long reported statements scored 0.29-0.64 (denied, does not believe, will not be responsible); a negated event ('was not rebuilt until') 0.04. The split between the + and - pole is not established.
